Importance of Loadcell Precision Measurement of web tension is essential to ensure consistent product quality and maximise productivity. Puretronics presents Loadcells for various automation applications to cover most of automation in converting and process machines. Measurement of tension value of all materials including paper, cardboard, films, foils, rubber, sheet metal, fabric, metal wire and can be installed in any zone of a web production process. > **Image Description:** A product family photograph displaying various load cells. The image includes flat rectangular models, cylindrical flange-mounted models with military-grade pin connectors, and a heavy-duty blue pillow-block mounted load cell. ### Strain Gauge Technology Wheatstone bridge illustrates the concept of a difference measurement, which is extremely accurate. The amplifier provides a stable excitation voltage of 10VDC to the force sensor. When load is applied the strain gauge is either elongated or compressed. This change in length leads to a change of overall resistance of the circuit. These changes are been calculated and readings are been displayed. > **Image Description:** A circuit diagram of a Wheatstone Bridge. A DC voltage source labeled \$U_\{EX\}\$ supplies power to a diamond-shaped bridge circuit consisting of four resistors: \$R_1\$, \$R_2\$, \$R_3\$, and \$R_4\$. The output voltage, labeled \$U_0\$, is measured across the middle of the bridge between the node connecting \$R_1\$ & \$R_2\$ and the node connecting \$R_4\$ & \$R_3\$. ### General Specifications

--- ## 4. Guide for Loadcell Selection > **Image Description:** A cross-sectional mechanical diagram showing a roller shaft mounted horizontally between two flange-mount load cells. The diagram highlights the internal placement of bearings, spacers, and circlips within the load cell housings. Either roller bearing or loadcell bearing should be used and the other bearing should be locked. For accurate measurement and more precise output roller bearing should have a lock and it is recommended that roller bearing should be locked. ### Wrap Configurations and Net Force Calculation It is important to select correct loadcell rating for an application. This can be determined by calculating the net force by choosing the wrap configuration diagram shown below. > **Image Description:** Three vector diagrams illustrating different web wrap angles around a tension roller. - **WRAP 1:** Tension Force \$F_T\$ is angled *above* the horizontal. Angle \$B\$ is the total wrap angle. Angle \$A\$ is the angle of the bisecting force vector relative to vertical. - **WRAP 2:** Tension Force \$F_T\$ is angled *below* the horizontal. - **WRAP 3:** Tension Force \$F_T\$ is exactly horizontal. **Wrap 1 Equation:**
\$\$NET\\ FORCE = \\frac\{4T \\sin(B/2) - W \\cos(A)\}\{2\}\$\$ **Wrap 2 Equation:**
\$\$NET\\ FORCE = \\frac\{4T \\sin(B/2) + W \\cos(A)\}\{2\}\$\$ **Wrap 3 Equation:**
\$\$NET\\ FORCE = \\frac\{4T \\sin(B/2)\}\{2\}\$\$ *(Where \$T\$ = Web Tension, \$W\$ = Weight of Roller, \$B\$ = Wrap Angle, \$A\$ = Angle of force relative to vertical)* The selected load rating may be 20% less than the computed Net Force. The actual force on the transducer will read 125% of the load rating before hitting the stops. This is acceptable because the Net Force formula contains an oversizing factor of 2, which means that the actual force exerted on the transducer will not exceed its rating. Sometimes, a roll is so heavy that its weight uses up most of the operating range of the transducer. At this condition since the adjustment range of the electronic circuit has been exceeded it may not be possible to adjust the tension indicating meter to read zero when tension is zero. **To rectify if the load is too heavy to adjust the tension meter at zero:** 1. Compare the load rating along with the effective weight of the roll. 2. If \$W \\cos(A)\$ is more than 95% of the load rating chosen, changes must be made to reduce \$W \\cos(A)\$ to less than 95% of the load rating: - Reduce the transducer roll weight. - Increase angle (\$A\$). - Use the next higher load rating (This is the least desirable choice because it reduces transducer signal output). --- ## 5.
